description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentRowAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView adapter used in an Android app to display a list of content rows. Each row consists of a title and a horizontal list of content cards. The class manages view holder creation, data binding, and diffing for efficient list updates.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for displaying a list of ContentRow objects in a RecyclerView, with each row containing a title and a nested horizontal RecyclerView of content cards.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the list of content rows to display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for a content row item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a given position.

nested_classes.name: RowVH
nested_classes.description: ViewHolder class for the content row layout, manages title TextView and inner RecyclerView.

methods.name: RowDiff
methods.description: DiffUtil callback object to optimize list updates by comparing items.
